statement: For each actual F19--F24 inclusion mathcal K_sign <= R_sign <= V_sign and every continuous rho:V_sign->Aff_1(k) over a finite field of characteristic p, put M=rho(mathcal K_sign), N=rho(R_sign), D=chi(V_sign), C=chi(R_sign), U=M intersect the additive translation group, k0=F_p(D), k1=F_p(C). The additive subgroup U is k1-linear. For every such representation with U k0-linear one has M=N. Consequently equality holds for every representation with C=1 or k0=k1, and for every map to Aff_1(F_p), for every prime p. The exact coefficient maps and actual scalar lift in M are constructed. Unequal scalar fields without the ambient linearity property, full marginal equality and K+=D+ remain unresolved.
depends_on: F21 actual normal generation in D+; F22 actual surjection D+->R_sign carrying K+ onto mathcal K_sign; F23 explicit sign comparison underlying F24; F24 continuous rank-one crossed-homomorphism restriction injection over every finite field
manuscript_passages: Part F root-adjoining intersection question; Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; original F7/F19 residual subgroup-membership reduction.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. All actual marginal inclusions, completed source maps and sign comparisons remain those of F19--F24.
computational_checks: No new computation is required: the claim is a complete field-linear deduction from the independently verified F24 restriction injection. Its proof explicitly verifies the affine conjugation formula, constructs a scalar complement inside the actual marginal image, proves the linear annihilator intersection and checks the coefficient-map crossed-homomorphism equation. Separate F9 exploratory calculations are recorded in the report without being used as proof for this statement.
notes: The core hypothesis is exactly U being a vector subspace over the scalar field k0=F_p(chi(V)); the equality k1=k0 is a proved sufficient property because U is stable under chi(K)=chi(R)=C. Choose an actual lift m=(b,c) in M of a generator c of C; its fixed point z=b/(1-c) gives the literal conjugated group M_z=U semidirect C. Each k0-linear annihilator ell of U makes ell(d_z) an actual F24 cocycle. Its vanishing forces d_z(V) into U, so N_z=M_z and the inverse translation gives equality. The character-trivial case is proved directly from F21 abelian normal generation. No complement or ambient invariant quotient is assumed in the unresolved scalar-field case.
